# Memristor_Device

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A two-terminal non-volatile memory device whose resistance state can be programmed by applied voltage/current, often used as synaptic or reservoir elements. Provides emerging CMOS-compatible hardware for implementing reservoir computing nodes with high density and low power in network processors.
